mechanism: Amikacin is nephrotoxic and can impair renal function, leading to reduced clearance of duloxetine and its metabolites, increasing duloxetine exposure and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) regularly; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; adjust duloxetine dose if renal impairment develops; assess for duloxetine toxicity symptoms.
